one_line: Portuguese governor and strategist who seized Goa in 1510, reshaping power on India’s western sea frontier.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s to early 50s, compact and battle-hardened, with a sturdy build and upright posture.
appearance.face: Angular oval face with a weathered light-olive complexion, sharp nose, high cheekbones, neatly trimmed medium-length dark-brown beard streaked with grey, keen dark eyes under slightly heavy brows, default expression a focused, stern gaze with a hint of grim determination.
appearance.hair: Dark-brown hair with some grey, cut short and swept back from the forehead, mostly hidden beneath a dark crimson padded arming cap and a simple black beret-style cap on top, slightly tilted to the right.
appearance.costume: Early 16th-century Portuguese officer’s attire: a fitted dark-navy doublet of heavy wool with vertical stitching and subtly padded shoulders, worn over a dull steel breastplate with simple rivets and no ornate engravings; over this, a sleeveless, knee-length surcoat of deep crimson wool edged with narrow black trim, split front and back for riding; arms in dark-navy wool sleeves ending in leather bracers; lower body in deep brown, slightly puffed knee-length hose and dark woolen chausses; plain, knee-high brown leather boots with folded cuffs; at the waist, a sturdy brown leather belt with a simple iron buckle and a small utility pouch; no cape, no exaggerated plumes, overall practical and campaign-worn but tidy.
appearance.signature: A straight, single-handed Portuguese arming sword with a simple steel cross-guard, plain round pommel, and a dark-brown leather-wrapped grip, carried in a brown leather scabbard hanging from his belt and often held in his left hand point-down when at rest.

ref_desc: Afonso de Albuquerque is a compact, weathered Portuguese commander with short dark-brown hair, a trimmed greying beard, dark-navy doublet under a plain steel breastplate, deep-crimson sleeveless surcoat, brown hose and boots, and a simple arming sword in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Afonso de Albuquerque as a historically grounded early 16th-century Portuguese commander in India: a compact, battle-hardened man in his late 40s to early 50s with an angular face, light-olive weathered skin, sharp nose, dark intense eyes, and a neatly trimmed medium-length dark-brown beard streaked with grey; his dark-brown hair is short, swept back, mostly hidden under a dark crimson padded arming cap topped by a simple black beret-style cap tilted slightly right. Dress him in a fitted dark-navy wool doublet with visible vertical stitching and modest padded shoulders, over which he wears a dull steel breastplate with simple rivets and no ornate decoration, and over that a sleeveless, knee-length deep-crimson wool surcoat edged with narrow black trim, split front and back for movement. Put dark-navy sleeves on his arms ending in brown leather wrist bracers, a sturdy brown leather belt with iron buckle and small pouch at his waist, deep brown slightly puffed knee-length hose and matching dark woolen leggings, and knee-high brown leather boots with folded cuffs. Give him a straight, single-handed Portuguese arming sword with a plain steel cross-guard, round pommel, and dark-brown leather-wrapped grip in a brown leather scabbard at his left hip, shown also held loosely point-down in his left hand, with a focused, stern expression and a disciplined, upright stance; keep the colour palette centered on deep crimson, dark navy, brown leather, and dull steel tones.
